note: Both sets contain many chart-read claims that cannot be verified precisely, but Set A keeps more claims tied to the real span positions (e.g. FFA-W3-241 64%, FFA-W3-301 44%, FFA-W3-211 100%) and gets plausible total-thickness and foam values at those stations. Set B misbinds several whole-stack totals to glass_biax (42 mm, 32 mm, 22 mm, 28 mm) and to medium_density_foam (41 mm, 38 mm), and invents span positions (47%, 88%, 94%, 41%) and a non-existent station 'FFA-W270blend 54%'. Set A also errs (invented positions 38/44/47/50/85%, misbound 42/35/38/42 mm values, the 'FFA-W3-310blend' typo, and the misread of 'FFA-W3-270blend 54%' as a thickness), but fewer of its claims are wrong overall.
